purpose.statement: DevOps Asiana exists to provide professional accountability for technology operations in an increasingly AI-operated computing environment. The Firm provides professional technology operations, engineering, reliability, infrastructure, security, integration, and related advisory services, and supervises, authorizes, operates, reviews, verifies, and stands behind technology work performed by human professionals, automation, software systems, and artificial-intelligence agents within defined Client Engagements and delegated authority.
initial_market_specialization: Other institutions operating regulated or critical technology infrastructure
purpose.scope_boundary: The constitutional purpose remains broad enough to serve other organizations operating critical information or technology infrastructure.
purpose.professional_doctrine: AI can perform the work. The Firm accepts responsibility for the work.

decisions.label: Equal Founding Partner governance
decisions.statement: Lester B. Hurtado and Angelica Anaïs C. Santos each hold 50% governance weight.

decisions.label: Founding economic allocation
decisions.statement: Engagement Contribution is allocated 30% to Lester, 50% to Anaïs, and 20% to the Firm Allocation.

decisions.label: Institutional purpose
decisions.statement: The Firm exists to provide bounded professional accountability for AI-amplified technology operations, initially serving regulated or critical financial infrastructure while retaining a broad institutional purpose.

decisions.label: Initial capital contributions
decisions.statement: No amount, form, timing, or contribution obligation has been decided.

decisions.label: Capital ownership and liquidation interests
decisions.statement: Governance and Engagement economics do not determine capital interests.

decisions.label: 50/50 governance deadlock mechanism
decisions.statement: No deadlock escalation, mediation, casting vote, buy-sell, or dissolution mechanism has been selected.

decisions.label: Founder dilution protection mechanics
decisions.statement: Founder protections are intended; their legal mechanics, limits, and duration require counsel.

decisions.label: Partner retirement mechanics
decisions.statement: Notice, transition, economic treatment, and redemption have not been decided.

decisions.label: Partner death and incapacity mechanics
decisions.statement: Authority is personal and economic value may survive, but implementation remains unresolved.

decisions.label: Buyout and redemption valuation
decisions.statement: No valuation method, date, funding method, or payment terms have been selected.
